blocked_on: The Ni-PAP geometry is not in this repository, and neither charge nor multiplicity is recorded anywhere that can be checked. legacy/Template.py carries spin = 2 and a Ni/N basis assignment with the geometry block left empty. Supply the structure and confirm the charge and spin state.
title: Ni-PAP complex, the eventual stress test
description: The molecule the original work was about. It is deliberately last: it is the case that proves the workflow scales, not the case the workflow is developed against. Everything above it should be passing before a run here is worth the queue time.

active_space.notes: The 21-orbital step reproduces the active space legacy/Template.py used. The larger steps are the point: the manuscript reported state ordering changing when the active space or basis was expanded, so the sweep has to be run before any ordering here is quoted.

solver.notes: From legacy/input.dat, whose nocc line lists 16 orbitals.

provenance.basis_source: legacy/Template.py assigns 'anoroostz' to Ni and N.
provenance.notes: The per-element basis here covers only the elements legacy/Template.py named. It has to be completed once the actual composition of the complex is known.
